Your CAD view. Photoreal in under a minute.
Same camera, same design, real light. Then pick a mood.
First render is free → https://www.vaultworkspace.com/?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cad-to-render

For 13 years, the slowest part of my design work wasn't designing.
It was waiting for renders.

So I built Vault.
Take a view from any CAD or 3D software, press Render.
Same camera. Same design. Real light, in under a minute.
Then try it at blue hour, or in the rain.

First render is free: https://www.vaultworkspace.com/?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cad-to-render
